data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6133 commenced underwriting in 2018 and therefore opened the year with no gross claims outstanding. There are no prior-year reserve movements to report for 2018 (first underwriting year). The syndicate's 2018 calendar result was materially affected by a series of large natural catastrophe events (notably Hurricanes Florence and Michael, Typhoons Jebi and Trami and Californian wildfires), producing significant current-year claims and a reported loss for the year.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2018 results reflect a number of large natural catastrophe events including Hurricanes Florence and Michael, Typhoons Jebi and Trami and Californian wildfires.
As a mono-line Property Treaty reinsurer writing US and International catastrophe business significant result volatility is expected.
The large losses noted above have hit the 2018 year and will therefore impact significantly the result on closure.
data.data_quality_notes: This syndicate commenced underwriting in 2018 (first underwriting year). Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2018 is shown as nil in the Technical Provisions note. There are no prior underwriting years, so prior-year development is not applicable and is reported as null. Financial statement amounts in the report are presented in US Dollars and in $'000 in the notes; primary numeric fields above are reported in millions (native currency). The segmental analysis only states 'All business written by the syndicate is reinsurance', so the gross premium mix contains a single 'Reinsurance' line.
